question: Whose consecration is twofold, and whose vessel-rule differs?
premises: twofold his consecration — not thus in the pure vessel is the rule
thus this glorious grace-descent, independent, here declared
inference: Impure needs double consecration; pure vessel differs; descent is independent.
uncertainties: dviguna reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: Twofold his consecration — not thus in the pure vessel is the rule; thus this glorious grace-descent, independent, here declared.
